claims.summary: Package export derives a CourseIR source-proof fallback only when source-backed pipeline state expects proof and the exported graph has no source rows.
The fallback writes URL/DOI/license-free CourseIR rows as sourceReviewRows and SOURCE_REPORT.md review notes instead of trusted sourceLedger bibliography.
Focused exporter regression coverage recreates the missing-ledger failure without weakening source-thinness, review-row, or fake-citation grader checks.
